name: xplorio
description: Xplorio: a touch interface for Volumio with tag editor, history, discovery and lyrics, on its own port.
author: Celindir69

volumio_info.details: Xplorio is an alternative interface for Volumio (playback, library, discovery, tag editor, history). It runs on its own port, so nothing below /volumio changes and system updates keep working.
volumio_info.changelog: First version as a plugin: interface on its own port, tag service and Rotel bridge as services of the plugin, all settings on the plugin page.
